definition: 0.25 m XZ cell centers with 0.25 m height bins rasterized from actual NavMesh triangles. Count cell area (0.0625 m²); horizontal finite-segment radius 0.5 m, height difference <=0.25 m. Separate stacked floors remain distinct.
weighting: area weighted: sum covered cells / sum available NavMesh cells; not equal scene weighting
scope: Only locally available NavMeshes with matching sidecar SHA; missing scenes have no fabricated denominator.
